headline: European Commission publishes an AI Act harmonized-standards decision for high-risk systems
summary: The European Commission’s official AI standards index lists Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274, adopted on October 12 and published in the Official Journal on October 14, as concerning harmonized standards for high-risk AI systems under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. This is a current step in the Act’s standards process. The linked legal text could not be retrieved in this review, so the specific standard references and detailed requirements remain unverified; no provider adoption or compliance outcome is established.
